name: xiaohongshu-interview-research
title_zh: 小红书面经抓取器：登录一次，按公司/岗位/批次归档
tagline_zh: 秋招/暑期实习面经散在小红书，手动复制粘贴到吐。它能自动搜索、提取正文与图片链接，按公司别名、岗位、批次归类。
tagline_en: Tired of copy-pasting interview notes from Xiaohongshu? It auto-searches, extracts text & image links, classifies.
desc_en: Collect, cache, normalize, and summarize Xiaohongshu job-search interview experience notes with Playwright. Use when Codex needs to manually-login to Xiaohongshu, search campus hiring or internship interview posts by company/role/recruitment type, extract note metadata/text/image links, classify company aliases, roles, autumn recruiting or summer internship type, interview rounds, OCR/vision statu
why_zh: Playwright 驱动真实登录，绕开反爬；内置公司别名归一化与秋招/暑期实习分类。
why_en: Real-login Playwright bypasses anti-bot; built-in alias mapping & batch classification; caches raw data to avoid re-scraping.
limit_zh: 需要你手动扫码登录小红书一次，且依赖 Playwright 环境。只抓公开笔记，不处理需关注/私密内容。
limit_en: Requires manual QR login once & Playwright env. Only public posts; no follower-only content. Images are saved as links, not OCR'd—you'll need a.
title_en: Xiaohongshu interview scraper: login once, archive by.
